FAQ

Can an AI receptionist schedule dental appointments?Many can take requests or book into a calendar, but practice-management integrations vary. Ask the vendor about your specific system before buying.
Is it HIPAA compliant?We don't verify compliance claims. Ask each vendor for their healthcare terms (for example a BAA) before routing patient calls through them.
What is the cheapest option?Smith.ai has a free plan for 25 calls a month. My AI Front Desk is $99/mo with 200 minutes.
